name: jevtool
description: Claude Code plugins that use Jev, TypeSafe's System One model, for fast, calibrated judgments: guard risky tool calls, evaluate Jev judgments on your own data, and check agent deliveries.

plugins.name: jev-guard
plugins.description: Before Claude runs a shell command, writes a file or fetches a URL, Jev scores the risk. Destructive, exfiltrating or out-of-scope actions are blocked or sent to you for approval. Never auto-approves anything.

plugins.name: jev-eval
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to turn your data into a labeled Jev test suite and run jevtool eval: accuracy, misses, a safe confidence cutoff, and what changes between Jev versions.

plugins.name: jev-verify
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to check its own delivery against an acceptance checklist, the Git diff and freshly executed tests before saying it is done.
